=== [D3] Fix 2: "Use a runtime to run the Effect" ===

--- file:///.src/runEffectInsideEffect_exit.ts ---
// @effect-v3
// @effect-diagnostics discardedRunPromiseToRunFork:off
import { Effect } from "effect"

const child = Effect.succeed(1)

export const sameScope = Effect.gen(function*() {
  Effect.runSync(child)
  Effect.runSyncExit(child)
  yield* Effect.void
})

export const nested = Effect.gen(function*() {
const effectRuntime = yield* Effect.runtime<never>();

  yield* Effect.void
  setTimeout(() => {
    Runtime.runPromise(effectRuntime)(child)
    Effect.runPromiseExit(child)
    Effect.runSync(child)
    Effect.runSyncExit(child)
  }, 0)
})

--- file:///.src/runEffectInsideEffect_exit.ts ---
// @effect-v3
// @effect-diagnostics discardedRunPromiseToRunFork:off
import { Effect } from "effect"

const child = Effect.succeed(1)

export const sameScope = Effect.gen(function*() {
  Effect.runSync(child)
  Effect.runSyncExit(child)
  yield* Effect.void
})

export const nested = Effect.gen(function*() {
const effectRuntime = yield* Effect.runtime<never>();

  yield* Effect.void
  setTimeout(() => {
    Effect.runPromise(child)
    Effect.runPromiseExit(child)
    Effect.runSync(child)
    Runtime.runSyncExit(effectRuntime)(child)
  }, 0)
})
